gameName: Dead of Winter: A Crossroads Game

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Dead of Winter rules (Plaid Hat Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Colony board in the center with the 6 location cards around it
Choose a main objective and set the board up as its card says
steps.note: First game: We Need More Samples

steps.text: Crisis cards shuffled onto the colony board
Survivor, exiled objective and crossroads decks shuffled to the side
Item cards sorted by location, shuffled and placed on their location cards
Secret objectives: set aside {n} non-betrayal cards, add 1 betrayal card, shuffle and deal 1 each; box the rest unseen
Shuffle the starter items and deal {n} to each player
Deal 4 survivors each: keep 2, one as group leader and one in your following
Standees of all chosen survivors in the colony
Blue marker on the morale track, red marker on the round track
The player whose group leader has the highest influence takes the first player token
